sourceFile: 13. BRS-161014  Report check PT measure coplanarty 2023.11.22_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not reliable because it misidentifies the changed factor and converts header rows into false measurement results.
issues: Changed factor is a filename, not the Type 1 vs Type 2 coplanarity condition.
Baseline and test conditions are not defined from cited rows.
Measurement subresults use headers/sample numbers as data, creating invalid stats and violations.
Outcome grouping misses or underuses actual result and decap bond data rows.
Evidence citations mostly support table structure, not final measurements or judgement.
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor as Type 1 under 0.01 mm versus Type 2 0.01 to 0.02 mm, if supported by source rows.
Extract actual coplanarity values from data rows, not header/sample-number rows.
Separate coplanarity measurement outcome from decap bond spread-glue outcome under the same validation context.
Cite rows containing specifications, measured values, NG rates, notes, and decision.
Remove supplier/domain claims unless explicitly evidenced.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are semantically insufficient; final evidence needs cited data and decision rows.
